narrative: 画面中的地位高低，来自镜头所处的位置以及俯仰角度。平视（Eye Level）拒绝赋予这种地位差异。
两个人如果处于相同的视线高度，看起来就是平等的；房间不会俯视他们，他们也不会显得高高在上。他们坐下时，摄影机也坐下。
他们站起来时，摄影机也站起来。如果画面中要传达任何评判，那也应该来自表演、服装或灯光，而不是来自机位的几何关系。
如果情节需要的是监视感、纪念碑感，或地图式的视角，那就用错了工具。哪怕只是几度的俯仰变化，你实际上就已经切换到了高角度（High Angle）或低角度（Low Angle）。
只要降低几英寸，你就进入了肩高机位（Shoulder Level）的范畴——那是一种同行者的视角，而不是真正的平等。
how: 让镜头的节点与被摄对象的眼睛高度对齐。保持横滚角为零，使垂直线保持垂直。
35mm到50mm的焦距能让透视关系接近人眼的观感；即便高度相同，广角镜头依然会拉伸房间的空间感，但不会改变地位关系。高度和俯仰角是两个独立的变量：一台位于眼睛高度、却向下看的摄影机，已经不再是平视镜头，而是一个从眼睛高度出发的高角度镜头。
把提示词写成：camera at their eye height, horizon level, no tilt up or down。
when: 适合用在不应偏袒任何一方的对话场景，或者希望观众相信一张脸、而不被摄影机暗中说服的场景。具体场景：两个成年人坐在厨房餐桌前，视线高度相互对齐，画面中不出现天花板。
除非你确实有意为之，否则不要向下或向上看。
vs: 高角度（High Angle）向下俯仰，让人物显得渺小。低角度（Low Angle）向上仰视，让人物显得高大。
肩高机位（Shoulder Level）位于眼睛下方几英寸处，就像一位同行的伙伴。主观镜头（Point of View）是角色所看到的画面，而不是站在其旁边、同样高度的摄影机。
过肩镜头（Over-the-Shoulder Coverage）在前景中保留一具身体的一部分；平视镜头则可以是一个干净的单人镜头（Single）。
examples_film: 《东京物语》（Tokyo Story）把家庭对话保持在人的视线高度，让姿态而不是权力性的俯仰角度来传达评判。《罗塞塔》（Rosetta）始终跟随她自己的视线高度移动，拒绝俯视她。
把这些当作语法规则：让摄影机高度匹配画面中的人物，并保持地平线的诚实。
mistakes: 常见的错误替代是轻微的低角度（Low Angle），因为生成模型往往把肖像当成海报来处理。破绽在于：画面中出现天花板、从下巴以下的角度拍摄、垂直线向内收拢。
解决办法：摄影机保持在眼睛高度，地平线水平，不做俯仰。如果被摄对象是坐着的，摄影机也要坐下来；站立姿态下对一个坐着的人保持“平视”，实际上已经是在俯视了。

faq.q: 电影中的平视（Eye Level）是什么？
faq.a: 平视镜头把摄影机放置在被摄对象的眼睛高度，并保持地平线水平。视线是水平的，因此画面不会通过俯视或仰视来分配权力关系。
平视与被摄对象的视线高度对齐，并保持水平。高角度镜头则把摄影机升高并向下俯拍，使画面中出现更多地面，人物在画框中所占的比例也随之缩小。
当关系应该显得平等时使用它：对话、见证，或作为默认的覆盖镜头。当情节需要从上方表现脆弱感，或从下方表现纪念碑式的伟岸感时，跳过它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频生成平视的提示词？
faq.a: 写：Eye-level shot of [Subject], camera at their eye height, horizon level, no tilt up or down. 注明坐姿还是站姿，以免模型对坐着的人物产生俯视效果。

narrative: Rank in a frame comes from where the lens sits and how it is pitched. Eye-level refuses that assignment.
Two people at matching eye height read as peers; the room does not look down on them, and they do not loom. Sit when they sit.
Stand when they stand. The judgment, if any, has to come from performance, costume, or light, not from geometry.
It is the wrong tool when the beat is surveillance, monument, or a map. A few degrees of pitch and you have already cut to a High Angle or a Low Angle.
A few inches down and you are in Shoulder Level, which is a companion, not a peer.
how: Match the nodal point to the subject's eyes. Keep roll at zero so verticals stay vertical.

A 35mm to 50mm keeps perspective close to human vision; a wide from the same height will still stretch the room without changing rank. Height and tilt are independent: a camera at eye height that looks down is no longer an eye-level shot, it is a high angle from eye height.
Prompt it as camera at their eye height, horizon level, no tilt up or down.
when: Use it for a conversation that should not take sides, or for a face you want believed without the camera lobbying. Concrete beat: two adults at a kitchen table, seated eyes matched, no ceiling grab.
Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
vs: High Angle pitches down and shrinks the figure. Low Angle pitches up and grows it.
Shoulder Level sits a few inches below the eyes, like a walking companion. Point of View is what the character sees, not a camera beside them at the same height.
Over-the-Shoulder Coverage keeps a near body in the foreground; eye-level can be a clean Single.
examples_film: Tokyo Story holds domestic talk at human height so posture, not a power tilt, does the judging. Rosetta stays with her at her own eye line as she moves, refusing a look down.
Use those as grammar: match height to the person in the scene, keep the horizon honest.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a mild Low Angle, because generators treat a portrait as a poster. Tell: ceiling in frame, chin from below, verticals converging.
Fix: camera at eye height, horizon level, no tilt. If the subject is seated, sit the camera; standing eye-level on a seated person is already looking down.

faq.q: What is eye level in film?
faq.a: An eye-level shot places the camera at the subject's eye height with a level horizon. The sightline is horizontal, so the frame does not assign power by looking up or down.
Eye level matches the subject's eyes and stays level. A high-angle shot raises the camera and pitches it down, so more floor enters and the figure occupies less of the rectangle.

faq.q: When should I use eye level?
faq.a: Use it when the relationship should read as equal: talk, witness, default coverage. Skip it when the beat needs vulnerability from above or monument from below.

faq.q: How do I prompt eye level for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write: Eye-level shot of [Subject], camera at their eye height, horizon level, no tilt up or down. Name sit versus stand so the model does not look down on a seated body.
